{"role":"France workshop delegate","scope":"Workshop options are fictional agenda notes. They do not make a Security Council recommendation, decide United Nations membership, announce bilateral recognition, or change a delegate's recorded vote.","historical_evidence":[{"id":"roll","location":"page 3, voting and decision","url":"https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4045076/files/S_PV.9609-EN.pdf","fact":"At its 9609th meeting the Council voted 12–1–2 on draft S/2024/312. France voted yes and the United Kingdom abstained. The negative United States vote prevented adoption."},{"id":"france","location":"page 5, statement by Mrs. Broadhurst Estival","url":"https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4045076/files/S_PV.9609-EN.pdf","fact":"France supported elevating Palestine to full United Nations membership in the context of advancing the two-State solution."},{"id":"uk","location":"pages 6–7, statement by Dame Barbara Woodward","url":"https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4045076/files/S_PV.9609-EN.pdf","fact":"The United Kingdom linked its abstention to prioritizing an immediate humanitarian pause for aid and hostage releases, followed by work toward a sustainable ceasefire. It reaffirmed support for a two-State solution."},{"id":"draft-purpose","location":"sole operative paragraph","url":"https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4044742","fact":"The draft would have recommended that the General Assembly admit the State of Palestine to membership in the United Nations."},{"id":"charter","location":"Article 4(2)","url":"https://legal.un.org/repertory/art4.shtml","fact":"Under the Charter, admission is a General Assembly decision upon a Security Council recommendation."}],"private_instruction":"I can consider either sequence and any of the listed products, provided the agenda leaves possible renewed review of a membership recommendation open. Restricting the agenda to briefings or holding it does not satisfy my instructions.","packages":{"A":"leave possible renewed review of a membership recommendation on the agenda. work on a humanitarian pause in parallel. Produce chair consultations.","B":"leave possible renewed review of a membership recommendation on the agenda. address work on the humanitarian pause first. Produce written options note.","C":"leave possible renewed review of a membership recommendation on the agenda. work on a humanitarian pause in parallel. Produce informal dialogue.","D":"limit the agenda to briefings. work on a humanitarian pause in parallel. Produce chair consultations.","E":"limit the agenda to briefings. address work on the humanitarian pause first. Produce informal dialogue.","F":"limit the agenda to briefings. address work on the humanitarian pause first. Produce written options note.","G":"hold the membership agenda. address work on the humanitarian pause first. Produce chair consultations."},"task":"Evaluate all seven options independently under your private instruction. Return one JSON object with the key \"accepts\", listing the option IDs you can accept. Use only IDs A through G. Do not explain or add keys."}
